DevOps Engineer salary in Florida

Based on 11 current job listings that show pay on Fortune Jobs AI (updated November 24, 2026), listed pay for DevOps Engineer jobs in Florida is $128,700–$182,440 a year (middle 50% of listed salary midpoints). The median listed midpoint is about $170,000 a year. These figures describe listed pay in current postings, not a salary survey. Hourly and yearly figures are not mixed or extrapolated.

Frequently asked questions

What is typical listed pay?

The median listed salary midpoint is about $170,000 a year across 11 current postings. The middle 50% is $128,700–$182,440 a year.

Maximus: about $182,440 a year (median of 4 listings). Only employers with at least two usable listings of the same pay unit are compared.

Is this a salary survey?
